briefing.text: Attackers are probing two critical PHP flaws, and some public sites went offline.
China's DeepSeek is reported to be raising about $15 billion.
Modern Warfare 4 launches Friday, including on Switch 2, after strong campaign reviews.
DC's Clayface opens Friday with 75% on Rotten Tomatoes and a $25-30 million forecast.
Apple's $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo goes on sale Friday with limited walk-in stock.

stories.title: Modern Warfare 4 launches Friday, with its campaign earning strong reviews
stories.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases October 23 on PS5, Xbox, PC and, for the first time, Switch 2.
stories.why: Call of Duty is one of the best-selling series in games, and this is its first launch on a Nintendo console in years.
stories.happened: Campaign reviews include 8/10 from IGN, marked not final, and 9/10 from Insider Gaming, Nintendo Life reports. The campaign moves from a North Korean invasion of South Korea to New York, Paris and Mumbai. Full multiplayer and DMZ verdicts are still to come.
stories.next: Watch for final review scores covering multiplayer and DMZ, and early sales figures.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Call of Duty is usually among the year's best-selling games in the US.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is the first Modern Warfare game on a Switch console.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It no longer launches into Game Pass, after Xbox removed new Call of Duty games.

stories.background: Call of Duty is Activision's shooter series, now owned by Microsoft. Infinity Ward made this game.

meme.top: Call of Duty is coming to Nintendo
meme.take: Modern Warfare 4 arrives on Switch 2, where it joins a library of mostly friendly plumbers.

stories.title: PHP2Shell flaws take sites offline as attackers start probing
stories.summary: Two critical PHP flaws found with AI help are being widely probed, and some public bodies pulled sites offline.
stories.why: PHP runs a large share of the web, so unpatched servers are an easy target.
stories.happened: PHP fixed the two flaws on October 21, and CISA urged quick updates. Finland briefly shut government web services, and the BBC and Edinburgh council took pages offline, The Neuron reports. Amazon saw an exploit attempt on October 17, four days before disclosure.
stories.next: Watch for confirmed break-ins using the flaws and how fast hosts and WordPress sites patch.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: PHP powers a large share of websites, including those built on WordPress.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: OpenAI says its model helped find the bugs before attackers did.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The flaws allow code to run on a server without logging in.

stories.background: PHP is a programming language that powers many websites, including those built on WordPress.

meme.top: AI found the bug before the hackers
meme.bottom: The hackers were four days behind
meme.take: AI found PHP's flaw first. Attackers arrived four days early for the disclosure anyway.

stories.title: DeepSeek is reported to be raising about $15 billion
stories.summary: China's DeepSeek is reported to be closing a round of about 100 billion yuan, double its original target.
stories.why: It would be one of China's largest AI raises and gives a rival to US labs far more money to spend.
stories.happened: Bloomberg and Reuters report DeepSeek is wrapping up a round of about $15 billion, with CATL and Tencent among reported investors. Reuters put the pre-money valuation near $75 billion. It comes two days after the US ordered DeepSeek out of federal civilian systems.
stories.next: Watch for DeepSeek confirming the round, its final investors, and any talk of a listing in China.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The round would be about double DeepSeek's original 50 billion yuan target, Reuters reports.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: DeepSeek is China's best-known challenger to US labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The news landed two days after a US order to remove its AI from federal systems.

stories.background: DeepSeek is an AI lab based in Hangzhou, China. Its open-weight R1 model drew global attention in early 2025.

meme.bottom: Funded by most of China instead
meme.take: DeepSeek lost a few US government laptops and gained about $15 billion.

stories.title: Clayface opens Friday with fresh reviews and a $25-30 million forecast
stories.summary: DC's R-rated horror film about the Batman villain has a 75% Rotten Tomatoes score ahead of its October 23 opening.
stories.why: It is the third film in DC's new movie universe and a test of whether a minor villain can carry a film.
stories.happened: Clayface held 75% on Rotten Tomatoes from 83 reviews on October 21, Forbes reports, above Supergirl's 52%. Boxoffice Pro forecasts a $25 million to $30 million opening. James Watkins directs, with Tom Rhys Harries in the title role.
stories.next: Watch for Thursday preview numbers and whether it beats A24's You Can See Everything for the weekend.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is DC Studios' third film after Superman and Supergirl.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces a widening A24 hit for the same adult audience.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Comparisons with Sony's Venom and Morbius show how far such films can swing.

stories.background: DC Studios, run by James Gunn and Peter Safran, makes films based on DC Comics and is part of Warner Bros.

meme.top: A villain who can become anything
meme.bottom: The studio would like a hit
meme.take: DC is betting on a villain who can become anything, ideally a box office hit.

stories.title: EA is closing BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect
stories.summary: The studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age is shutting as EA cuts about 400 jobs after its $55 billion buyout.
stories.why: BioWare made some of the most loved role-playing games of the last 30 years.
stories.happened: BioWare said early work on the next Mass Effect is ending. Bloomberg reports EA will cut about 400 jobs, roughly 3% of staff, including about 50 at BioWare. It follows EA's $55 billion buyout led by Saudi Arabia's PIF, which left about $18 billion in debt.
stories.next: Watch for what EA does with the Mass Effect and Dragon Age names now the studio is closing.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: BioWare made Baldur's Gate, Knights of the Old Republic and Mass Effect.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The buyout added about $18 billion in debt, and EA has promised big savings.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 400 jobs are going across EA, Bloomberg reports.

stories.background: BioWare was founded in 1995 in Edmonton and bought by EA in 2007. Its last game was Dragon Age: The Veilguard in 2024.

meme.take: BioWare spent 30 years making player choices matter. EA made one this week.

stories.title: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo goes on sale with thin walk-in stock
stories.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone launches October 23, with limited walk-in stock and some orders slipping to January.
stories.why: It is Apple's first folding phone and its most expensive iPhone yet.
stories.happened: Apple says stores will have limited Duo stock for walk-in customers, Tech Insider reports. Delivery times for some models slipped into January 2027 after preorders opened. Ten markets, including China, Japan and India, have online-order pickup only.
stories.next: Watch for launch-day queues, how fast stock sells out, and early sales estimates.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: A foldable iPhone has been rumoured for years.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: At $1,999 it costs more than any iPhone before it.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Shipping dates slipped soon after preorders opened.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone, the world's best-selling smartphone line. Samsung has sold foldable phones since 2019.

meme.top: Apple made a phone that folds
meme.take: The iPhone Duo folds in half. At $1,999, so will a few savings plans.

stories.title: Claude Duet opens its waitlist, running on an unreleased Opus 5.5
stories.summary: Anthropic opened a US waitlist for Claude Duet, a proactive assistant it says runs on its unreleased Opus 5.5 model.
stories.why: Assistants that work between messages are the next big race, and this one names a new top model.
stories.happened: The research preview is open by waitlist to US Pro and Max subscribers on iOS, Android and the web. Duet sends morning briefings, keeps working after you step away, and asks for approval before acting for you. It has more than 6,000 connectors.
stories.next: Watch for wider access to Duet and any formal release of Opus 5.5 itself.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Anthropic's first app built around an assistant that acts before being asked.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It confirms a new top Claude model, Opus 5.5, before its own launch.

stories.background: Anthropic makes the Claude AI models and is one of the largest AI labs, alongside OpenAI and Google DeepMind.

meme.top: Claude will now brief you at dawn
meme.take: Claude Duet works while you sleep and still asks first. Better manners than most software.

stories.title: Final screen tests for the next James Bond are reported to be underway
stories.summary: Amazon MGM and director Denis Villeneuve are said to be testing a shortlist of actors in London.
stories.why: Casting a new 007 is one of the biggest decisions in film, and the role has been open since Daniel Craig left.
stories.happened: The Guardian and The Hollywood Reporter report final screen tests in London covering stunts, camera presence and dialogue. Reports differ on whether two or up to five actors remain. Empire and THR name Callum Turner, Jack Lowden and Josh O'Connor.
stories.next: Watch for an official casting announcement, which Amazon says will come when the time is right.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: James Bond is one of the longest-running film series in history.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have speculated about Daniel Craig's successor for years.

stories.background: Amazon bought MGM, home of the Bond films, in 2022. Denis Villeneuve directed the Dune films.

meme.take: The next Bond faces stunts, camera tests and dialogue. The martini is the easy part.

stories.title: Capcom confirms a breach of its Capcom ID accounts
stories.summary: Account details of more than 11 million Capcom ID users are reported to be exposed, but not card data.
stories.why: Capcom ID links players to games like Monster Hunter and Street Fighter, so many people are affected.
stories.happened: Capcom spotted suspicious activity on October 19 and reported it to Osaka police and Japan's privacy regulator on October 21. Exposed data includes emails, IP addresses and login IDs; 196 accounts had passwords changed without permission. Capcom says card data was not affected.
stories.next: Watch for Capcom's final count of affected users and any forced password resets.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 11 million accounts are reported to be affected.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Exposed emails and login IDs can be used in phishing attempts.

stories.background: Capcom is the Japanese publisher behind Resident Evil, Monster Hunter and Street Fighter.

meme.top: Capcom asked users to change passwords
meme.bottom: Card data stayed home. Emails did not.
meme.take: Capcom says no card data leaked. That is where the good news section ends.

stories.title: Google DeepMind researchers quit over the company's military AI work
stories.summary: Two researchers told the BBC they left over how Google's AI may be used by the Pentagon.
stories.why: It reopens a long-running fight inside Google over working with the military.
stories.happened: Research engineer Sofia Liguori resigned this week and researcher Andreas Kirsch left earlier in October, citing too little oversight of classified Pentagon uses, the BBC reports. Google says public-sector contracts are reviewed against its AI principles.
stories.next: Watch for more departures, staff letters, or Google spelling out its rules for defence work.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Staff are questioning whether Google can see how the military uses its AI.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: DeepMind is one of the world's best-known AI research labs.

stories.background: Google DeepMind is Alphabet's AI lab. In 2018 Google staff protests led it to leave the Pentagon's Project Maven.

meme.take: Two DeepMind researchers left over military AI. The compliance review is said to be ongoing.

stories.title: Xbox is reported to be planning an a la carte Game Pass
stories.summary: Fortune reports players could pick features like cloud play and multiplayer separately in a tiered Game Pass.
stories.why: Game Pass is Xbox's biggest bet, and this would change what millions of subscribers pay for.
stories.happened: Fortune reports Xbox CEO Asha Sharma plans a major Game Pass overhaul with tiers and add-ons such as cloud gaming and multiplayer, GameSpot says. Xbox has already removed new Call of Duty games, cut the price and charged extra for cloud time.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft confirming new tiers and prices, and any further Xbox job cuts.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Subscribers could end up paying more or less depending on the features they pick.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Xbox has made several Game Pass changes in a short time.

stories.background: Game Pass is Microsoft's subscription service for Xbox and PC games, launched in 2017.

meme.top: Game Pass is going a la carte
meme.bottom: The menu has never been longer
meme.take: Xbox may let you pay for each part of Game Pass. Customisable, like a phone bill.

stories.title: Nathan Fielder's Holmes film goes wide after winning Wednesday's box office
stories.summary: After a $15.6 million start from 855 screens, A24's You Can See Everything expands to 2,500+ screens on Friday.
stories.why: A comedian's documentary-style film is drawing young crowds and could beat a superhero film this weekend.
stories.happened: The film opened to $15.6 million from 855 screens with over 2,000 sellouts, Boxoffice Pro says, and topped Wednesday's box office, Deadline reports. It expands on October 23, with a weekend forecast of $15 million to $20 million.
stories.next: Watch for whether it tops Clayface for the weekend once it reaches more than 2,500 screens.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: About 70% of its opening audience was under 35, Boxoffice Pro reports.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is going head to head with DC's Clayface this weekend.

stories.background: Elizabeth Holmes founded the blood-testing company Theranos and was convicted of fraud in 2022.

meme.take: Elizabeth Holmes promised results nobody could verify. Nathan Fielder delivered $15 million.

stories.title: A trailer for the cancelled next Mass Effect leaks online
stories.summary: Footage said to be from the fifth Mass Effect game appeared on Reddit days after EA said it was closing BioWare.
stories.why: Fans are getting their first look at a game that will now never be released.
stories.happened: A trailer for what would have been the fifth Mass Effect game was posted to the series' Reddit community, Simulation Daily reports. It surfaced after EA announced BioWare's closure and the end of work on the game.
stories.next: Watch for whether EA comments on the footage or says anything about the series' future.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans had waited years for the next Mass Effect after a 2020 teaser.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It leaked just days after the game was cancelled.

stories.background: Mass Effect is BioWare's science fiction role-playing series, which began in 2007.

meme.top: The next Mass Effect got a trailer
meme.take: Mass Effect finally showed its next game, in the most BioWare way possible: too late.

stories.title: Chip and hardware stocks slide in a broad tech sell-off
stories.summary: Coherent fell nearly 12% and IBM, Micron and Intel dropped sharply as tech stocks sold off on October 22.
stories.why: Chip stocks have led the AI boom, so a sharp drop feeds worries about an AI bubble.
stories.happened: Nasdaq futures fell 1.6% before Thursday's open, with IBM down over 5% and Micron, SK Hynix and Intel about 4%, KuCoin News reports, amid Iran tensions and AI bubble worries. GuruFocus says Coherent fell 11.85%. JPMorgan said most long positions may already be unwound.
stories.next: Watch for big tech earnings next week, which could steady or deepen the slide.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Chipmakers have been among the market's biggest winners from AI spending.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Analysts cite AI bubble worries and rising oil prices.

stories.background: Micron, SK Hynix and Intel make the memory and processors used in AI servers.

meme.top: The AI trade had a bad Thursday
meme.bottom: The AI said it was a correction
meme.take: Chip stocks fell hard. JPMorgan says most of the people who could panic already have.

stories.title: Micron workers in Taiwan stage the island's first chip strike
stories.summary: Union members at Micron's Taoyuan plant walked out for 24 hours over how AI memory profits are shared.
stories.why: Taiwan makes much of the world's advanced chips, and AI memory is in short supply.
stories.happened: The 24-hour walkout began at 9 a.m. local time on Thursday at Micron's Taoyuan fab, Nikkei Asia reports, calling it Taiwan's first semiconductor strike. 99% of 1,994 voting members backed the action.
stories.next: Watch for talks between Micron and the union, and whether further walkouts are called.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Nikkei Asia calls it the first strike in Taiwan's chip industry.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The dispute is over sharing the profits from booming AI memory sales.

stories.background: Micron is a US maker of memory chips, including the high-bandwidth memory used in AI servers.

meme.top: AI memory sells at record prices
meme.bottom: The workers have seen the numbers
meme.take: Micron's chip workers read the AI boom headlines too. Then they read the strike ballot.

stories.title: A Glee reboot gets the green light at Disney+ and Hulu
stories.summary: Disney+ and Hulu greenlit a new Glee, and Lea Michele is reported to be returning as Rachel Berry.
stories.why: Glee was a huge hit in the early 2010s, and its fans have wanted a revival for years.
stories.happened: BroadwayWorld reports that Disney+ and Hulu have greenlit the reboot, which had been teased before. Lea Michele is reportedly set to play Rachel Berry again, more than a decade after the original series ended.
stories.next: Watch for confirmed cast, which original stars return, and a premiere window.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Glee was one of the biggest TV shows of the early 2010s.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Lea Michele's return is the casting fans most wanted.

stories.background: Glee was a Fox musical comedy-drama from Ryan Murphy that ran from 2009 to 2015.

meme.take: Disney has revived Glee. Somewhere a show choir just felt vindicated.

stories.title: Meta's revenue jumps 26% while legal costs and AI spending squeeze profit
stories.summary: Meta made $64.6 billion in Q3 but took a $9.9 billion legal charge and raised its yearly spending outlook.
stories.why: Meta is one of the biggest AI spenders, and investors watch whether ads can keep paying for it.
stories.happened: Revenue rose 26% to $64.6 billion. Net income was $9.86 billion after a $9.89 billion charge tied to youth-related litigation with state attorneys general. Capital spending reached $34.91 billion, and the 2026 outlook is now $135-145 billion.
stories.next: Watch for whether Meta's 2027 spending plans grow again and how its shares hold up.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Free cash flow turned negative at about $2.1 billion for the quarter.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Meta's 2026 capital spending outlook tops $135 billion.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and makes most of its money from advertising.

meme.bottom: And spent slightly more than that
meme.take: Meta grew revenue 26% and spending faster. The classic AI-era business model.

stories.title: Walmart opens its store to approved AI shopping agents
stories.summary: Walmart's Agent Gateway lets approved AI agents search stock and buy, with spending caps per agent.
stories.why: Retailers are deciding whether AI agents become customers, and Walmart has picked a side.
stories.happened: Walmart CEO John Furner launched Agent Gateway, an MCP server for approved AI agents, on October 21, TechCrunch reports. Agent Profiles give each agent its own account with spending caps and per-purchase approval. Amazon has been blocking agent purchases.
stories.next: Watch for which AI assistants plug into Walmart first and whether Amazon changes course.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Walmart is welcoming the AI shoppers that Amazon has been blocking.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI agents that buy things for people are one of the year's big bets.

stories.background: Walmart is the largest US retailer. MCP is an open standard that lets AI assistants connect to outside tools.

meme.top: Your AI can now shop at Walmart
meme.bottom: With a spending cap, like a teenager
meme.take: Walmart gave AI agents allowances. Parenting has entered retail.

stories.title: OpenAI's models are coming to Google Cloud
stories.summary: Google Cloud customers will get OpenAI's frontier models and Codex through Model Garden and its marketplace.
stories.why: It puts OpenAI on a rival's cloud, loosening its long reliance on Microsoft.
stories.happened: OpenAI said Google Cloud customers will access its frontier models and Codex through Model Garden, buying through Google Cloud Marketplace. Eligible firms can put existing Google Cloud commitments toward them, with general availability planned in the coming weeks.
stories.next: Watch for general availability dates and whether more OpenAI models reach other clouds.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: OpenAI will sit on the same platform as Google's own Gemini models.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Businesses can spend existing Google Cloud budgets on OpenAI models.

stories.background: Google Cloud is Alphabet's cloud business. Microsoft has been OpenAI's biggest backer and main cloud partner since 2019.

meme.top: OpenAI is now sold by Google
meme.bottom: On the shelf right next to Gemini
meme.take: Google Cloud now stocks Gemini, Claude and GPT. The house always wins.

stories.title: Private equity firms are said to have valued Xbox at $100-150 billion
stories.summary: The Information reports brief, exploratory buyout talks about Xbox that never reached Microsoft as a formal offer.
stories.why: Any hint that Microsoft could sell Xbox would reshape the console business.
stories.happened: The Information reports private equity firms discussed a buyout and valued Xbox at $100 billion to $150 billion, Pure Xbox says. The talks were short-lived. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has said Xbox is not for sale.
stories.next: Watch for any further statement from Microsoft on Xbox's future inside the company.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $100 billion-plus price tag would be one of the biggest deals in gaming.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Fortune reports some staff believe Xbox could be readied for a sale or spinoff.

stories.background: Microsoft bought Activision Blizzard for about $69 billion in 2023, making Xbox one of the largest game publishers.

meme.bottom: But someone checked the price anyway
meme.take: Private equity valued Xbox at up to $150 billion. Microsoft would like people to stop asking.

stories.title: Final Fantasy Resonance is out now after strong early reviews
stories.summary: Square Enix's HD-2D game launched October 22 on consoles including Xbox, PS5 and Switch 2.
stories.why: It is a classic-style Final Fantasy, the kind many long-time fans have asked for.
stories.happened: Square Enix's turn-based HD-2D game launched on October 22, including on Xbox. Pure Xbox reported very strong early reviews, mostly of the PS5 and Switch 2 versions, and Famitsu's four critics each gave it 9 out of 10.
stories.next: Watch for early sales figures and how it ranks on Japan's weekly charts.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Its pixel-art HD-2D look recalls the series' 1990s games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Turn-based Final Fantasy games have become rare.

stories.background: Final Fantasy is Square Enix's role-playing series, running since 1987.

meme.bottom: Final Fantasy fans call that a warm-up
meme.take: Final Fantasy Resonance takes 70 hours to finish. Series fans call that a long weekend.

stories.title: Barclays plans about 5,000 job cuts as AI raises productivity
stories.summary: The bank is cutting about 5% of its workforce, with roughly 60% of roles in support functions.
stories.why: It is one of the clearest cases of a big employer linking job cuts to AI.
stories.happened: Barclays disclosed the cuts with its third-quarter results, Business Insider reports. About 60% of affected roles are in support functions, including software development. Finance director Anna Cross said AI is raising productivity and changing the cost base.
stories.next: Watch for which countries and teams the cuts hit and whether other banks follow.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 5,000 jobs, roughly 5% of the bank's staff.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Banks are among the first big employers to tie cuts to AI.

stories.background: Barclays is a British bank with large retail and investment banking businesses.

meme.take: Barclays found AI boosts productivity. The reward is being distributed unevenly.

stories.title: Tesla's profit falls 44% even as it beats forecasts
stories.summary: Tesla's Q3 net income fell to $787 million, but adjusted EPS of $0.48 beat estimates.
stories.why: Investors are weighing Tesla's falling car profits against its bets on robots and robotaxis.
stories.happened: Net income fell 44% to $787 million on roughly flat revenue of $28.05 billion, AP reports. Operating income dropped 56% to $718 million while R&D rose 69%, Electrek reports. Free cash flow was about $1.5 billion.
stories.next: Watch for updates on Optimus robot production and the robotaxi rollout.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Elon Musk's companies draw coverage far beyond the car industry.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: R&D spending rose 69% to $2.76 billion as AI work grows.

stories.background: Tesla is the electric car maker led by Elon Musk. It also sells energy storage and is building humanoid robots.

meme.take: Tesla made less money than last year and more than expected. Both are true.

stories.title: Recursive releases Flint, a small open coding model built by an automated lab
stories.summary: Flint has about 40 billion parameters, uses 2.5 billion per token and is free under Apache 2.0.
stories.why: A strong coding model that runs on a laptop could cut costs for developers.
stories.happened: Recursive, Richard Socher's startup, says Flint was produced by its automated AI research system. AI Weekly reports 89.7% on SWE-bench Pro v2. Socher said it can top 125 tokens per second on a MacBook Pro.
stories.next: Watch for independent tests of Flint's benchmark scores and how developers rate it in real use.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It activates only about 2.5 billion parameters per token, small enough for a laptop.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Open coding models are closing in on paid ones for everyday tasks.

stories.background: Richard Socher is an AI researcher who founded the search engine You.com.

meme.top: An AI lab built a coding model
meme.take: Recursive's model was made by an automated research system. The org chart is getting shorter.

stories.title: Dario Amodei defends Anthropic's safety record against a long critique
stories.summary: Anthropic's CEO answered Encode AI's Nathan Calvin in a 2,000-word post and admitted some missteps.
stories.why: It is a rare public back-and-forth between a lab chief and safety advocates over whether the lab kept its word.
stories.happened: Calvin listed nine actions he said undercut Anthropic's safety promises. Amodei replied on X on October 20, citing a four-month hold on a Mythos-class model and limits on sales to Chinese state-linked firms. He said some points had merit, including the handling of a draft safety bill.
stories.next: Watch for Calvin's reply and how Anthropic's draft federal safety bill is received.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Critics ask whether racing to the frontier fits with a safety-first brand.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amodei rarely answers a critic point by point in public.

stories.background: Anthropic makes Claude. Encode AI is a youth-led group that campaigns for AI safety rules.

meme.take: Amodei answered nine complaints with one essay. In AI, that is a fast response time.

stories.title: Jailer 2 passes Rs 317 crore net in India in its first week
stories.summary: Rajinikanth's sequel made Rs 28.15 crore on Wednesday, taking its India net total to Rs 317.20 crore, Sacnilk reports.
stories.why: Rajinikanth is one of India's biggest stars, and the sequel is 2026's top Tamil film so far.
stories.happened: Per Sacnilk, Jailer 2 earned Rs 28.15 crore net in India on its seventh day for a Rs 317.20 crore total, with 33.7% occupancy across 14,438 shows. It opened on October 15 and is nearing the original Jailer's lifetime India total.
stories.next: Watch for whether it passes the first Jailer's lifetime India total in its second week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Rajinikanth has led Tamil cinema's biggest hits for decades.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It played more than 14,000 shows on its seventh day.

stories.background: Tamil cinema, often called Kollywood, is the film industry based in Chennai, India. Jailer came out in 2023.

meme.take: Jailer 2 made Rs 28 crore on a Wednesday. Most films would frame that.

stories.title: AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1 billion at a $6 billion value
stories.summary: The year-old research startup's Series A was led by Index Ventures and Lux Capital.
stories.why: Investors are still writing very large cheques for young AI labs with no product yet.
stories.happened: Flapping Airplanes raised $1 billion at a $6 billion valuation, led by Index and Lux, with Sequoia, GV and Kleiner Perkins joining. That is four times the value of its seed round in January, which raised about $180 million.
stories.next: Watch for what the lab says it will build with the money and when it shows its first work.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $1 billion Series A is huge for a company about a year old.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Top venture firms keep backing new AI research labs.

stories.background: Index Ventures, Lux Capital and Sequoia are large venture capital firms that back technology startups.

meme.take: Flapping Airplanes quadrupled its value in nine months. The name was apparently not a warning.

stories.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie hits Netflix in the US on November 30
stories.summary: The year's first $1 billion film streams on Netflix earlier than forecasters expected, after its Peacock run.
stories.why: It is 2026's biggest animated film, and families have been waiting for it on Netflix.
stories.happened: What's on Netflix reports a US Netflix date of November 30, with the film staying on Netflix until September 30, 2027. It opened in theaters on April 1 and has streamed on Peacock since July 30. Forecasts had pointed to early December.
stories.next: Watch for how high it climbs in Netflix's Top 10 over the holiday weeks.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It passed $1 billion worldwide, the first 2026 film to do so.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands just after Thanksgiving weekend, ahead of the holidays.

stories.background: The Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023) was made by Illumination with Nintendo and grossed over $1 billion.

meme.take: Mario finished his Peacock run and moved to Netflix. The princess was in another app.

stories.title: Anthropic pitches a law that could halt a model judged too dangerous
stories.summary: Anthropic's draft bill would let the Commerce Department ask a court to suspend a model over catastrophic risk.
stories.why: It would give the US government a way to stop an AI release, which no law does today.
stories.happened: Under the draft, the Commerce Department could ask a federal judge to halt a model posing an imminent risk of more than 50 deaths or over $1 billion in damage, TechCrunch reports. The Neuron notes open questions over who evaluates the models.
stories.next: Watch for whether any member of Congress picks up the draft and how other AI labs respond.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: No US law currently lets the government stop a model release.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It sets a bar that other AI labs would also have to meet.

stories.background: Anthropic makes Claude and has long argued for safety rules on the most powerful AI models.

meme.top: Anthropic wrote a bill to stop AI
meme.take: Anthropic drafted a law that could halt a model. Investors will read the fine print.

stories.title: PS5 sales rise while Xbox hits a September low in the US
stories.summary: Circana's September figures show PS5 up 22%, Switch 2 down 14% and Xbox Series down 27% from a year ago.
stories.why: Console sales show which platforms are winning as prices rise across the board.
stories.happened: US hardware unit sales fell 3% in September, Circana data shows, Pure Xbox reports. PS5 rose 22%, Switch 2 fell 14% and Xbox Series fell 27%, a new September low. The average price paid for an Xbox rose 33% to $663.
stories.next: Watch for October's figures, which will include Modern Warfare 4's launch.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Sony gained while Nintendo and Xbox fell.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Average console prices rose sharply from a year ago.

stories.background: Circana tracks US video game sales. Its monthly report is the main public measure of US console sales.

meme.take: Xbox raised prices and sold fewer consoles. Economists can finally stop arguing about this.

stories.title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25 billion in New Mexico's privacy case
stories.summary: The penalty covers nearly 44 million violations tied to Cambridge Analytica, and Meta plans to appeal.
stories.why: It is a very large penalty over user data, even by Big Tech standards.
stories.happened: Judge Francis Mathew ordered the $25 billion penalty on October 21 after a September jury verdict, Source NM reports. It is far below the possible maximum of more than $219 billion. Meta plans to appeal.
stories.next: Watch for Meta's appeal and whether other states bring similar cases.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: A jury found more than 43 million violations of state law.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: $25 billion is a large sum even for Meta.

stories.background: Cambridge Analytica was a political consultancy that got data on millions of Facebook users, which came to light in 2018.

meme.take: A judge set Meta's penalty at $25 billion, which counts as good news in this line of work.

stories.title: Nvidia shows a data center that ships in containers at GTC Berlin
stories.summary: Nvidia's DSX POD packs its Vera Rubin design into containers it says cut deployment to about 14 days.
stories.why: Getting AI data centers built faster is one of the biggest bottlenecks in the industry.
stories.happened: At GTC Berlin on October 21, Nvidia launched DSX POD, a containerised Vera Rubin design, with first deliveries slated for early 2027. It also named six suppliers, including Ibiden and Amkor, to expand substrate and packaging capacity.
stories.next: Watch for the first DSX POD customers and whether the 14-day claim holds in practice.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Nvidia says deployment drops from about six months to 14 days.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia sets the pace for nearly every AI data center build.

stories.background: Nvidia makes most of the chips used to train and run AI models.

meme.top: Nvidia put a data center in a box
meme.take: Nvidia can ship a data center in 14 days. The power company keeps its own schedule.

stories.title: Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.5 is out, with Edgerunners 2 content and mods
stories.summary: CD Projekt's Edgerunners 2 update arrived October 22 and adds cross-platform mod support on consoles.
stories.why: It is another big update for a game CD Projekt once said was finished.
stories.happened: Version 2.5, called the Edgerunners 2 update, went live on October 22 with content tied to the new Netflix anime, Pure Xbox reports. It adds cross-platform mod support, and Cyberpunk 2077 now supports Xbox Play Anywhere.
stories.next: Watch for which mods reach consoles first and whether player counts rise.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrived two days after Edgerunners 2 launched on Netflix.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Console players have long asked for mod support.

stories.background: CD Projekt Red is the Polish studio behind The Witcher games and Cyberpunk 2077.

meme.bottom: Two years ago, and again now
meme.take: CD Projekt said Cyberpunk was finished two years ago. Night City had other plans.

stories.title: eMudhra quits the web certificate business after its keys proved guessable
stories.summary: The Indian certificate authority is leaving the global SSL/TLS market after keys for eight certificates were recovered.
stories.why: Certificate authorities underpin the padlock in your browser, so a weak one is a real risk.
stories.happened: A researcher recovered private keys for eight of eMudhra's intermediate CA certificates, The Hacker News reports. Mozilla dropped trust for Firefox on October 20, and Chrome plans to follow around October 27.
stories.next: Watch for Chrome's change and how sites using eMudhra certificates switch providers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Guessable keys could let someone fake a secure website.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is rare for a certificate authority to exit the market over such a flaw.

stories.background: Certificate authorities issue the digital certificates that browsers use to confirm a website is genuine.

meme.bottom: Were easier to guess than Wi-Fi codes
meme.take: eMudhra secured the web with keys someone could guess. It has now left the web.

stories.title: Laika's stop-motion epic Wildwood opens with perfect early reviews
stories.summary: Travis Knight's adaptation of the Colin Meloy novel opens October 23 with a 100% Rotten Tomatoes critics' score.
stories.why: Laika makes some of the most admired animated films, and big stop-motion releases are rare.
stories.happened: Wildwood opens in the US on October 23 through Fathom Entertainment. Boxoffice Pro lists it at 100% with critics and 98% with audiences on Rotten Tomatoes. Variety calls it Laika's most ambitious feature yet.
stories.next: Watch for its opening weekend and whether it joins the animated film awards race.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Critics are calling it one of Laika's best, a studio with a loyal following.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Stop-motion films on this scale take years to make by hand.

stories.background: Laika is the Oregon studio behind Coraline and Kubo and the Two Strings. Colin Meloy leads the band The Decemberists.

meme.top: Made one frame at a time
meme.bottom: Reviewed one rave at a time
meme.take: Laika spent years moving puppets by hand. Critics replied at the same pace, unanimously.

stories.title: First previews of Sega's Stranger Than Heaven are mostly positive
stories.summary: RGG Studio's 50-year crime drama impressed most critics after a three-hour session ahead of its January 15 release.
stories.why: It is the first new series in years from the Yakuza and Like a Dragon studio.
stories.happened: Critics played about three hours in London, Pure Xbox reports. IGN called the reworked combat a major change, while Push Square was not yet sold on it. The game arrives January 15, 2027, including on Game Pass on day one.
stories.next: Watch for more footage before launch and how the combat lands in full reviews.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: RGG Studio is known for the Yakuza and Like a Dragon series.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: CGMagazine called it its most anticipated game of 2027.

stories.background: RGG Studio is a Sega development team. Its games are known for detailed Japanese city settings.

meme.top: A crime story across fifty years
meme.bottom: The side quests will take another fifty
meme.take: RGG Studio's new game spans five decades. Its players will need about as long.

stories.title: Palantir says it cannot remotely switch off NATO's AI system
stories.summary: Palantir told Reuters neither it nor the US government can disable the Maven Smart System NATO uses.
stories.why: European officials have worried about relying on US tech that Washington might control.
stories.happened: Louis Mosley, Palantir's executive vice president for the UK and Europe, told Reuters on October 22 there is no remote kill switch for Maven Smart System at NATO's military headquarters. NATO acquired the system in 2025. The claim has not been independently tested.
stories.next: Watch for NATO's own comment and whether European states press for more control of military software.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Europeans fear US tech could be switched off in a crisis.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Palantir is one of the most watched defence tech firms.

stories.background: Palantir is a US data analytics company whose software is used by militaries and governments.

meme.top: Palantir says there is no off switch
meme.take: Palantir promised NATO its software cannot be switched off. Normally that is the complaint.

stories.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix, with Hideo Kojima in the cast
stories.summary: The 10-episode standalone sequel to the 2022 anime launched on October 20, and a matching game update is out.
stories.why: The first Edgerunners revived interest in Cyberpunk 2077, and fans hope the sequel does the same.
stories.happened: CD Projekt Red and Studio Trigger made the series, directed by Kai Ikarashi, with Hideo Kojima as Hideyoshi Oshima. Cyberpunk 2077 version 2.5, the Edgerunners 2 update, went live on October 22.
stories.next: Watch for its Netflix Top 10 placing and whether it lifts Cyberpunk 2077's player numbers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Hideo Kojima, maker of Metal Gear, appears in the cast.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The first season is one of the best-loved game adaptations.

stories.background: Cyberpunk 2077 is CD Projekt Red's open-world game set in the dystopian Night City.

meme.top: A new season of Night City
meme.take: Edgerunners 2 is here. Night City remains a terrible place to live and a great place to watch.

stories.title: LiteLLM blames a leaked GitHub token for its poisoned release
stories.summary: LiteLLM says its release pipeline was hijacked on October 21 to push a malicious 1.107.0 build to PyPI and Docker.
stories.why: LiteLLM sits between many apps and AI models, so a bad release can reach a lot of systems.
stories.happened: LiteLLM suspects a GitHub token leaked in its AI gateway logs let attackers push version 1.107.0, The Hacker News reports. The build carried a credential stealer and a backdoor. The package was quarantined and the Docker images removed.
stories.next: Watch for LiteLLM's full incident report and advice for users who installed the bad version.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Unpinned installs during the attack window pulled the malicious build.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attacks on open source packages used by AI developers are rising.

stories.background: PyPI is the main public library of Python packages, used by millions of developers.

meme.take: LiteLLM's attackers got in through its logs. Logs remain the most honest employees.

stories.title: Street Fighter faces a steep second weekend after its $31 million debut
stories.summary: Boxoffice Pro forecasts $8 million to $13 million for Street Fighter's second weekend.
stories.why: Game adaptations have opened big this year but often fall fast in week two.
stories.happened: Paramount's Street Fighter opened to $30.77 million from 3,575 screens, Boxoffice Pro says. It forecasts $8 million to $13 million this weekend, citing drops of 62% to 69% for recent game films such as Resident Evil.
stories.next: Watch for the size of its second-weekend drop against Clayface and Wildwood.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Recent game films lost about two-thirds of their audience in week two.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Street Fighter II was one of the defining arcade games of the 1990s.

stories.background: Street Fighter is Capcom's long-running fighting game series, first adapted for film in 1994.

meme.top: Round one went to Street Fighter
meme.bottom: Round two goes to the calendar
meme.take: Street Fighter won its opening bout. Second weekends are a different opponent.

stories.title: Oppo launches the Find X10 phones with up to three 200MP cameras
stories.summary: The Find X10 Pro Max has three 200MP sensors and a 7,150 mAh battery, starting at about EUR 1,799 in Spain.
stories.why: Phone makers are racing on camera specs, and this is one of the year's most loaded flagships.
stories.happened: Oppo launched the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max internationally, Cinco Dias reports. The standard model has two 200MP cameras and the Pro Max three. Both run ColorOS 17 on Android 17, with Spanish prices from about EUR 1,399 and EUR 1,799.
stories.next: Watch for camera reviews against Apple's and Samsung's flagships.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Three 200MP sensors is an unusually high camera count.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It lands the same week Apple's iPhone Duo goes on sale.

stories.background: Oppo is a Chinese phone maker and one of the world's largest smartphone brands.

meme.take: Oppo put 600 megapixels on one phone. Lunch has never been documented so thoroughly.
